commitment.checkboxHint: Read the full commitment before confirming. No additional documents are required.
commitment.ethicsIntro: Work with integrity, independence and within your expertise.
commitment.privacyIntro: Protect information when receiving and performing a service.
commitment.ethics4: Accept work within your competence; clarify the service scope and professional limitations before starting.
commitment.ethics5: Promptly report errors or an inability to remain objective; cooperate in clarifying and correcting the issue.
commitment.privacy4: Do not copy, publish, use as a public example or use client data for personal purposes without permission.
commitment.privacy5: Limit access to necessary data to authorized people; maintain confidentiality even after the service ends.
commitment.sectionHint: One confirmation covers both professional ethics and information confidentiality.
commitment.label: I commit to professional ethics and information confidentiality
commitment.hint: One shared commitment covers both EV4 and EV5. No documents are required for these groups.
commitment.title: Professional ethics and confidentiality commitment
commitment.description: Read both sections before agreeing. Your commitment is recorded with your application when you submit.
commitment.ethics1: Provide truthful information and work within your professional competence.
commitment.ethics2: Disclose conflicts of interest and do not misuse client applications or information for personal gain.
commitment.ethics3: Do not collude in or support fraud or tax law violations.
commitment.privacy1: Use user information and documents only to perform the agreed service.
commitment.privacy2: Do not disclose or share information without authorization; protect documents and access accounts.
commitment.privacy3: Notify Shared Hub of any incident or suspected information exposure so it can be addressed.
commitment.scrollToAccept: Read to the end to agree
